ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across >95% of the visible surface area, with high-intensity (white/tan) contrast limited to distal tip clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform contiguous low-intensity black field across the medial and central fluke regions; high-contrast irregular clusters of high-intensity pixels localized at the distal lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with significant vertical depth extending into the fluke nexus.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with variable pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge; includes a notable secondary macro-excision on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves originating at the median notch and tapering to the lateral distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast white and light-brown pixel clusters localized at the apical regions of both the left and right fluke tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe adjacent to the median notch; extensive barnacle colonization clusters at both lateral extremities.
